latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of alert-inspection skill.

- Performs device health inspection, alarm review, and report/Excel export using Python.
- Separately queries normal and abnormal hosts, generates standardized JSONs, and produces a Markdown inspection report.
- Exports one Excel workbook with exactly 4 required sheets: 巡检概览, 正常主机, 异常主机, 异常详细清单.
- Inspection report and Excel are always generated together—no partial deliveries or user prompts.
- Workflow and file outputs strictly follow documented structure, naming, and grouping rules.
